notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for transportation-handle identity across an additional-FOM join. The source uses only the official RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the rich base FOM, additional FOM module, transportation names, provider package, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies that existing transportation handles remain stable, that the newly composed transportation receives one shared handle distinct from HLAreliable, HLAbestEffort, and the base custom type, and that all selected handles round-trip through the standard name lookup services without asserting provider-specific allocation or registries. This is fixture-bounded evidence for IEEE 1516.1-2025 §12.12.6.19 p. 392 l. 259 and l. 268; runtime preservation evidence for l. 277 covers the two standard values exposed by the 2025 C++ binding only, not literal Enums.h immutability, because that header is not a public surface of the pinned C++ binding. The same base/extension fixtures provide selected IEEE 1516.2-2025 §6.2.11 evidence: successful FOM processing and public name lookup for the conforming custom names TckBestEffort and TckAdditionalTransport, and acceptance of both legal DIF reliable-field encodings (No and Yes). The API exposes no reliability-value accessor; invalid values, full §3.3 rejection boundaries, and runtime transport guarantees are not established.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador createFederationExecution, joinFederationExecution(additionalFomModules), getTransportationTypeHandle, getTransportationTypeName, resignFederationExecution, and destroyFederationExecution
